description: Family Rossi (Marco, Giulia and our two children). On the way to Milan Centrale on 3 March 2025 our taxi was hit by a van; Giulia and I were taken to the emergency room and the four of us missed the train to Zurich. Accident report from the police and booking attached. Only the two of us were injured; the children were fine.

decision.explanation: We have reviewed your claim description, the police accident report, and the booking confirmation. The missed departure is supported by those documents, but we cannot confirm whether the incident date falls within the policy period or whether the claim was submitted within 30 days of the policy ending, because the policy period and policy end date are not stated. We also cannot confirm trip cancellation or rescheduling coverage because the documents do not state that the trip was cancelled or rescheduled and no medical report is provided. Personal effects coverage is also unresolved because the documents do not state that personal belongings were lost, stolen, or damaged. Your claim is therefore referred for review to resolve these open points.
